steps.name: Player 1
tips:
This is your Warlord.
He has an Attack value of 2.
Drag onto the enemy to attack.
You deal damage equal to your Attack value, lowering the enemy's Health.
The enemy fights back though! You also take damage equal to their Attack value.

steps.name: Player 2
tips: You win the match when the enemy Warlord’s Health drops to zero and dies.
However, if your Warlord dies first, you lose. Be careful!

steps.name: Player 3
tips: Initiate a normal attack, then switch to Ranged mode.
Now drag your Warlord onto the Primaris Reiver to do a Ranged Attack.
Always choose your attack mode carefully. Deal as much damage as you can while taking as little in return.

steps.name: Player 4
tips: You draw one card per turn, and can hold up to 8 cards at once.
Deploy your Primaris Intercessor by dragging the card onto the battlefield.
Newly-deployed troops can’t attack until the next turn.

steps.name: Player 5
tips: Defeat the Primaris Reiver with your Intercessor with a Ranged Attack.

steps.name: Player 6
tips:
Playing a card costs Energy.
Each turn, your Energy replenishes and increases by 2.
You can accumulate 1 Energy per turn not consuming all your Energy. You will get 1 more your next turn.

steps.name: Player 7
tips: You don’t need to attack every turn. Sometimes it is wiser to hold back.

steps.name: Player 1
tips: Most units have special abilities. Makari gives adjacent units a Melee Attack bonus.

steps.name: Player 2
tips: The Tide trait lets you play multiple copies of the same card this turn.

steps.name: AI 2
tips: Click on a card to see what it does. Hover over a trait to see its definition. Try it with Makari.

steps.name: Player 3
tips: Troops with Mob trigger an effect when a friendly unit does a Melee attack.
Take control! Deploy Makari, attack with your units, and end the turn when ready.

steps.name: Player 4
tips: Stratagems are special cards that have an instant effect on the battle.

steps.name: AI 4
tips: Units with Vanguard protect other friendly units from being attacked.

steps.name: Player 5
tips: Warlords and some troops have Talent. Each turn, they create a Stratagem in your hand.
Cards with Ephemeral will disappear at the end of the turn if they are not used.

steps.name: Player 6
tips: It’s now up to you to drive back the Space Marines. Use what you've learned to win this battle!

steps.name: Player 1
tips: Many Necron troops have the Remnant trait. When killed, they leave a Remnant on the board.

steps.name: AI 2
tips: Remnants can be Reanimated with certain cards and abilities. Some troops trigger a special effect when Reanimated.

steps.name: Player 2
tips: Remnants only remain in play until the end of their owner's turn.

steps.name: Player 4
tips: Troops with Artifice trigger the effect when using a stratagem.
Some troops trigger a special effect when Reanimated.

steps.name: Player 5
tips: Attacking or damaging a Remnant will destroy it.

steps.name: Player 6
tips: Carry on playing and finish off your opponent.

steps.name: Player 2
tips: This Troop will deal 2 damage to an enemy when receiving a Dark Pact.
The Dark Pact of Blood gives the troop +2 Melee Attack and Vanguard.

steps.name: Player 3
tips: The Noise Marine gains a Dark Pact of Excess when your warlord takes damage.
The Dark Pact of Excess grants +2 Melee Attack and +2 Ranged Attack.

steps.name: Player 4
tips: More than one Dark Pact can be stacked on a troop.

steps.name: Player 5
tips: Vulnerable amplifies the damage received by enemies.

steps.name: Player 6
tips: The Dark Pact of Resilience gives +1 Health and Regeneration 1.

steps.name: Player 7
tips: The Dark Pact of Fate grants +2 Health and Camouflage.
Troops with Strike trigger an effect when attacking.
Some cards amplify their effects based on the number of Dark Pacts on your troops

steps.name: Player 8
tips: It’s now up to you to defeat Tigurius. Finish him off!

steps.name: Player 1
tips: When attacking with a unit with Shuriken, it will immediately deal its Shuriken damage.
If this damage defeats the enemy unit, it will not have the chance to retaliate.
Remember that the Shuriken ability only triggers when attacking!

steps.name: Player 4
tips: Units with the Waystone ability will drop a Spirit Stone when destroyed.
Click on the Spirit Stone to collect it.
You can keep the tally of collected Spirit Stones here.
If you have enough Spirit Stones, some cards will consume them when played to trigger additional effects.

steps.name: AI 5
tips: Spirit Stones are destroyed when attacked or damaged.

steps.name: Player 7
tips: Both Troops and Stratagems can consume Spirit Stones to trigger additional effects.
Plan your actions carefully and decide when to collect and spend Spirit Stones.
Carry on playing and drive out the interlopers!

steps.name: Player 3
tips: Troops with Swarm can merge together into a single troop to add their stats.
To have two troops Swarm together, play the new troop to the LEFT of the one in board.

steps.name: Player 5
tips: Sometimes you will not want your troops to Swarm together, even if they can.
If you play your troop anywhere OTHER than LEFT of a troop on board with the same name, they will not Swarm.

steps.name: Player 6
tips: Units with Synapse transfer the benefits of Stratagems you play on them to adjacent units

steps.name: Player 7
tips: Some troops will provide additional effects when you trigger Synapse on a friendly unit.
Carry on playing and finish off Uriel Ventris.
